entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. Order number is 77-B-419-882.
Okay, I can help with that. Let me pull up order 77-B-419-882... I see it's for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. And it looks like it was delivered 19 days ago, on January 8th.
Right. So how do I send it back?

I can certainly check the options for you. First, I just need to ask one quick clarifying question. What specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's not a fault. I don't need it. I was supposed to start training, but my deployment got moved up unexpectedly due to an emergency.
I see. Our policy for returns outside the initial 10-day window is typically for technical issues only...

Look, on top of the deployment, my father had to have urgent surgery last week. I was at the hospital with him right before I had to leave. The box is unopened. I just missed the window because of all that. Can you help me or not?

I'm very sorry to hear about your father's surgery, and I hope he's recovering well. And thank you for your service. Given the circumstances with the medical emergency and your deployment, I can absolutely make a one-time exception for you. That is not a problem at all.

Yes, a full refund. I've just authorized the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just attach that to the box and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Okay. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit and have a great day.
